title: Lesson 30: General Systems Architecture: Testing AI Systems: Evals, Golden Sets, Canaries, and Regression
description: The testing discipline AI systems demand in place of the unit test: evals as structured tests, golden sets as the regression anchor, and canaries as the production safety net.

questions.question: How do capability checks and regression checks differ in what they expect and what they are for?
options: Capability checks start at a low pass rate; regression checks stay near complete.
Capability checks stay near complete, while regression checks deliberately start at a low pass rate.
Both kinds start low and both are expected to climb toward completion.
Both kinds stay near complete, since both confirm behavior that already works.
questions.explanation: A capability check is a hill to climb that starts low, while a regression check is a safety net held near complete, so a drop on the capability suite cannot answer whether something broke.

questions.question: What makes a golden set trustworthy as the anchor for regression runs?
options: It holds only hand-written happy-path examples that the system already passes.
It is built once and frozen so the baseline never moves again.
It mirrors production traffic, including edge and adversarial cases.
It scores model outputs with fluency measures such as perplexity and BLEU.
questions.explanation: A set that does not reproduce real traffic is a biased design, and because production keeps changing the set has to be grown and refreshed to stay a faithful reference.

questions.question: Why is watching only error rate and latency not enough when canarying a new model version?
options: Because error rate and latency cannot be measured on live production traffic.
Because a model can be technically healthy yet produce worse reasoning, tone, or accuracy.
Because canaries apply only to infrastructure changes and not to models.
Because output variability makes error rate and latency the only dependable signals to watch.
questions.explanation: Infrastructure dashboards can look clean while output quality quietly slips, so hallucination, coherence, judge, and business signals belong in the canary from the first stage.
